data.summary:
Management Professional with 15 years of IT experience in seeking assignments in Product Management / Project Management / Business Analysis Roles with an organization of high repute. SYNOPSIS
A dynamic Project Management Professional with Full Time M.B.A. with specialization in IT, Marketing & Business Analytics from Indian Institute of Management, Indore, certified with PMP along with excellent credentials throughout Academic Career. Strong Domain Expertise in BFSI-Trade Life Cycle Management, Post Trade Processing, US Regulatory Reporting (Axiom Tool), Securities & Capital Markets, Trade Finance, CORE Banking, Cash Management, Wealth Management, Retail Banking (KYC, Loan Processing, Cards, Channels, Payments-A.C.S, Gateways, Wallets, Processor On-boarding, Card on File Processing).
Adroit in Project Management, Product Management and Business Analysis in facets of information systems methodology from Requirement design through documentation, implementation, user training and quality review in both Agile (SCRUM) and Waterfall models in SDLC.
Maintained Product Backlog in Synchronization with Product Owner
, Conducted
Scrum Ceremonies to ensure that Requirements are in lines with Stakeholder expectations.
Expertise in Capturing Business, Functional & System Requirements, Composing Epics & User Stories and Developing BRDs, FRDs, RTMs, Use case Diagrams and Business Data Modelling. Handled Banking Clients like UBS, Lloyds Bank, Cynergy Bank, World Bank, Bank of America, VISA Inc, Travelers and Torus Insurance for their Digital Implementation Adept in JIRA, Confluence, HP Quality Center and Rally for capturing, tracking requirements and Project Statuses on Release (Sprint) Basis.
Possessing Fundamental Knowledge of XML, Comfortable in writing SQL queries and good knowledge of Non Functional Testing, Alteryx and Understanding Mainframe Copybooks. Experience in managing pre-sales activities within assigned Business Unit by involvement in developing solutions for winning project deals.
ORGANIZATIONAL SCAN Wells Fargo International Solutions Pvt Ltd Senior Assistant Vice President
Apr, 2023 Jun, 2026
Worked with stakeholders in Regulatory Reporting function of Finance to develop and deploy digital
solutions that simplify the automation of reports for internal use or for financial regulators.
Active like FRY9C,FFIEC031,FFIEC101,TIC,TFC,FR2510 Reports and ensured successful Signoff from Product Owner.
Involvement
in completion of Automation of multiple US Regulatory Reports
Formulated strategic direction for the automation of regulatory report creation processes by extensive SQL Data analysis & Advanced Excel Code for identifying Critical Inputs for deconstruction of VENA and provided simplified solutions to downstream teams for Axiom & Alteryx Automation implementation.
Wipro Technologies Senior Consultant
Sep, 2016 Mar, 2023
Developed Business Requirements including Process maps, detailed workflows, As-Is & To-Be Processes, Process Flows and other assigned Documents.
Handled Key Clients like UBS(Trade Life Cycle Management, Wealth Management, Margin Trading Facility), Lloyds Bank (CORE Banking, Lending & Collateral Management -LMS,LOS, VISA Inc(Payments), gathered critical Business/Project requirements, prepared BRD,FRD, NFR & RTMs and acted as Liaison among Business/Product Owner, SMEs, Development Teams ,Testing teams and other relevant stakeholders to ensure that the developed products had conformance with Client Expectations.
Demonstrated Leadership traits & Flexibility by taking up Myriad roles like Scrum Master, Agile Business Analyst & Domain Consultant for Banking Projects.
DHILIP DEVARAJAN
Organized Scrum Ceremonies to Track Requirements (Stories/Tasks) and communicate Sprint / Release Progress to all key stake Holders.
Ensured successful completion of critical projects by creating Epics, composing User Stories and guiding Developers & Testers with Right coverage of Information in Description, Definition of Ready, Definition of Done and Acceptance Criteria.
Fostered Easy enablement of Knowledge Management through Expertise in Atlassian JIRAs, Confluence, Rally and QC along with easy Traceability of Critical Documents.
Infosys Limited
Technical Test Lead (Level 5)
May, 2013 Sep, 2014
Coordinated with PMs, Technology, QAs and other staff to analyse project NFR test requirements for Client Bank of America CORE Banking, Retail Banking, Lending, Cards and Payments Functionality.
Interacted with client to gather requirements, prepared BRD, SRD, Functional & NFR requirements and Requirement Traceability Documents, prepared test strategy, test plan, formulated test cases, implemented best practices of script development and execution, analysed test results to ensure successful closure.
Owned the responsibility of Operations Activities within my Business Unit at Infosys including interpretation of Voluminous Data, Computation of revenue of Business Unit & follow-up with relevant stakeholders to avoid revenue mismatch.
Cognizant Technology Solutions
